Outcome.DescriptionText: Your away team enters the ruins and scans show a structure older than any known civilisation in the quadrant. Murals show a humanoid figure engulfed by energy. At the heart of the hall is a quantum data store in a stasis field. Its contents give your empire a 10% bonus to all scientific effort. As the team leaves, a huge automated warship drops out of warp. It is not friendly.

Your away team enters the ruins and scans show a structure older than any known civilisation in the quadrant. At the far end of the hall sits a powerful warship, intact and ready for flight. The team takes her up for a test run. As they leave the ruins, a huge guardian vessel appears on the horizon. It is not friendly.
